description: Every reason code the default scan can emit, one entry per detector family the Lean policy dispatches on plain codepoints (Unicode/Security/Policy.lean, familyTag) with the sub-threat tags of that family's Lean Classification.tag. scripts/check-fixture-coverage.py requires the shared verdict fixtures to reach every code here, and rejects a code emitted by any fixture that is not here. positionless lists the sub-threats whose classification localises nothing; whole_span lists the sub-threats whose firing condition covers the entire input (a tag-only input, a whole-field restriction level), so their positions are always the whole span by construction; unreachable lists sub-threats the reference cannot emit under any input, each with the reason, so the gate fails if one ever appears. Every other code must be reached with a strict, nonempty, non-leading subset of the input's positions. The position shapes recorded here are the Lean spec's: Unicode/Conformance/Security/CorpusDifferential.lean replays the fixtures through the Lean scan so the recorded verdicts, and the reference that produced them, are held to that spec, and a difference it reports is decided on the messageboard tracker (spec change with proofs re-run, or reference change with fixtures regenerated and every port following) before this file follows.

unreachable.CjkMix: fires only when the union has two scripts, the input is not highly restrictive, and the input is within a CJK covered set; highly restrictive is defined as single-script or within a CJK covered set, so the third condition contradicts the second (Unicode/Security/Identity/MixedScriptAdmissibility.lean detectWithContext, ports/rust/src/security/identity/homoglyph_confusable.rs mixed_script_verdict)
unreachable.UnrestrictedLevel: gated on an identifier field in both the Lean and the reference, where every codepoint outside Identifier_Status=Allowed already fires RestrictedStatusCp and a two-script union that is not highly restrictive already fires the mix rungs, so the Unrestricted level cannot be reached
